selection: Minimal compile closure of the frozen Wave8 gate-PGO detector. The files map preserves the original copied-byte hashes; reviewed repository-owned changes are recorded separately under owned_modifications.

dwell_input.h.rationale: Atomically reserve and reuse context-owned dual-receiver raw, normalized, and energy-prefix buffers for exact 20 ms sparse preparation while retaining the original conversion and prefix arithmetic. Other geometries use call-local preparation; LEO_NATIVE_GLRT_DISABLE_PREPARED_REUSE preserves shortened sparse preparation with per-call allocation, and LEO_NATIVE_GLRT_FULL_PREP preserves full-dwell preparation.

fine_precision.h.rationale: Separate the aligned FP32 FFT input, output, and FFTW_ESTIMATE plan from per-search spectra, epochs, and counters so one process-serialized context can reuse its plan. Every transform still clears the complete input, every output is copied into search-owned spectra, and each search releases all spectra and resets all counters. LEO_NATIVE_GLRT_DISABLE_FINE_PLAN_REUSE retains per-search plan creation.

full_search.c.rationale: Cache exact FP64 rotation vectors for clipped-grid irregular conditioned bins once per scoring call and share weighted-sample loads across four regular blocked dots while retaining each dot's original FP32 lane and FP64 reduction order. LEO_NATIVE_GLRT_SCALAR_BOUNDARY_DOTS retains cached rotations with scalar dots; LEO_NATIVE_GLRT_UNCACHED_BOUNDARY retains literal per-frame irregular rotations. Allocation failure keeps the original complete irregular-bin computation. An explicit internal parameter borrows the context-owned fine FFT workspace while preserving the original entry points with local plans. No bins, frames, candidates, rechecks, or GLRT work are removed.

full_search.h.rationale: Add a private prepared-search entry point that explicitly borrows an opaque fine FFT workspace. Existing callers retain the original local-plan entry point.
